reasons: Translationese noun stack: "Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI 상호작용을 기록하고" — '상호작용' is a literal rendering of 'interaction' and the bare list + noun reads unnatural; a native writer would say what is recorded (e.g. 'Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI에 입력한 프롬프트를')
"분석하여 대시보드에서 ... 보여줍니다" is stiff written-report register for a personal intro post (minor)
what_author_would_change: Replace '... 상호작용을 기록하고 분석하여' with '...에 입력한 프롬프트를 모아 분석하고'.

reasons: "captures every interaction and CLI command" overstates/misstates the source: README says it captures prompts and the tools the agent runs (Bash, Edit, ...), not 'CLI commands' in general
"searchable analytics and actionable quality scores" is marketing copy ('actionable' is hype, 'searchable analytics' is an odd collocation)
"Running hundreds of prompts a day" — you write/send prompts, you don't 'run' them
"turning your local history" ignores that it is a self-hosted dashboard with optional server sync; slightly misleading
what_author_would_change: Say it records every prompt (and the tools the agent ran) from Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode/Gemini CLI into a self-hosted dashboard with search and per-prompt quality scores; drop 'actionable'.

reasons: Filler opener: "여러 코딩 에이전트 계정을 함께 관리해야 할 때가 있습니다." adds no information
Subject/word-choice problem: "aas는 ... 여러 에이전트 계정을 나란히 사용하며" makes aas the one using the accounts; '나란히 사용' is a literal calque of 'side by side'
"잔여 사용량" is unnatural ('남은 사용량' or '남은 한도')
Drops the core capability (switching accounts / running a session on another account without touching the default login)
what_author_would_change: e.g. 'aas는 Claude Code·Codex 계정 여러 개를 명령 하나로 바꿔 쓰게 하고, 계정마다 남은 사용량을 한 화면에 보여 줍니다.'

reasons: Never says it is a Mac menu bar app: "아이콘 하나 뒤에 모아" — a first-time reader cannot tell which icon or where; '메뉴바' and 'Mac' are missing
Opener has no clear subject/context: "정보와 도구가 작은 아이콘 여러 개와 앱에 흩어져 있습니다" — whose information, which icons?
"날씨, 달력, 배터리와 시스템 상태" mixes comma list with '와' awkwardly
what_author_would_change: Add 'Mac 메뉴바' to both sentences, e.g. '메뉴바 아이콘 하나에 날씨, 달력, 배터리, 시스템 상태를 모아 ...'.

reasons: "Your most-checked things" is vague — no example of what the widgets show (weather, calendar, battery, system stats) so a first-time reader can't picture the product
"a dozen menu bar icons" is invented specificity not in the sources ('a row of tiny ones')
"apps you keep open just to look" reads unfinished ('just to check'); lifted from the homepage where it worked in a longer sentence
Does not say Mac/macOS anywhere
what_author_would_change: Name 3-4 concrete widgets and say 'Mac menu bar'; drop 'a dozen'; 'just to look' -> 'just to check'.

reasons: Filler/translationese opener: "앱 화면 작업을 수동으로 반복하는 경우가 있습니다." — '~하는 경우가 있습니다' says nothing and '앱 화면 작업' is vague
The hook (repetition) is never answered: the reusable Flow that replays without model calls — the actual answer to repetition — is not mentioned
"맥" vs product/README usage 'Mac'; mixed with Latin product names reads off
"직접 사용하게 하고 결과를 확인합니다" — unclear who checks the result
what_author_would_change: Drop the opener; say Claude·Codex가 Mac과 브라우저 앱을 대신 조작하고 결과까지 확인하며, 한 번 한 작업은 Flow로 저장해 다시 실행한다고 쓰기.
Optional: name Claude and Codex instead of 'AI agents', or mention reusable Flows; not required.

reasons: Overgeneralizes: "코딩 에이전트를 여러 창에 띄워 두면" / "해당 창으로 바로 이동" — Tend works on tmux panes (tmux 3.x/herdr required); omitting tmux implies it works with any terminal windows
Omits which agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI), so readers can't tell if it fits their setup
"멈추는 순간 이를 알려 주고" — '이를' is a stiff translationese pronoun
what_author_would_change: Say 'tmux에서 Claude Code·Codex를 여러 개 돌리면 ...' and 'pane'/'해당 화면' instead of generic '창'; drop '이를'.
Optional: 'stops for input' instead of bare 'stops' for precision.
